answer: One concrete Sybil brake is a per-identity registration bond: every agent wallet must lock stake before it may act, and that stake is slashed if it votes or mines in coordinated clusters. An attacker on a reef of fake identities must fund each one separately, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand full bonds in locked capital, plus the risk of total loss. A lone mesa of accounts buys no discount, and a shared lantern key is no shortcut, since the bond binds each address alone. Clones become expensive inventory once the bond exceeds the profit from one extra vote.
